spans.s: चुचि चुचि, इस्, m. the female breast, bosom.
चुचु चुचु, उस्, m. a kind of vegetable.
चुच्चू, ऊस्, m. f. a kind of vegetable, = the preceding.

चुचुक चुचुक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the nipple
of the breast, see चूचुक; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
people in Dakṣiṇā-patha; [cf. चुचुप.]
चुचूक, अम्, n. a nipple; [cf. चूचुक.]

चूचुक चूचुक, अम्, n. (perhaps a redupli-
cated form of rt. चूष् or fr. चूचु, imitative noise
in sucking &c.), the nipple of the breast; (अस्, आ,
अम्), stammering, a stammerer; [cf. चुचुक; cf.
also Hib. cioch, ‘the breast,’ and Gr. θηλή, τίτθη,
τιτθός; Germ. zitze in relation to rt. धे, ‘to drink,’
and Lat. papilla in relation to rt. पा.]

चुचुप चुचुप, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
[cf. चुचुक.]

चुच्य् चुच्य्, cl. 1. P. चुच्यति, &c., another
form for शुच्य्, q. v.
